decision_rules: Primary outcome is restored original-input full-VALID pooled AUROC with per-member mean/best, NLL and Brier secondary; report every paired seed and costs
Require qualified ordinary references and cross-fitted teachers; no teacher competence assumed from architecture/name
No complete-cycle selected state means no result for the all-TRAIN rotation hypothesis
Offset vs plain-CE difference can establish only the specified weighting policy; never a new binary contrast
All-zero-source recovery rejects necessity of source features for the observed effect; no source-evidence claim from analytic-null subtraction alone
Useful original-input benefit and prospective all-VALID transfer are both needed; TRAIN auxiliary skill alone is not generalization
Independent recovery removes a demonstrated shared-geometry advantage; report stored parameters separately from graph work
No priority, Bayesian validity, broad superiority, irreducible geometry or unused-task confirmation follows from this exploratory stage
additional_claim_gates_not_minimal_equiv: Competent original faithful BSNN retains author incidence-product/input-conditioned/per-layer sampling/ELBO-KL semantics; shared-private ensembling already exists
Structured global-latent/state-conditioned sampler can receive exact same offset CE; necessary before persistent factors are credited uniquely
Single predictor with same context tasks and capable joint multi-transport model before committee pooling is credited uniquely
Flat/node-frame/layer-shared plus matched node-capacity and private-feature/head replacements before private incidence geometry is credited irreducibly
